verdict.rationale: Secureframe publishes an llms.txt at secureframe.com/llms.txt and serves markdown variants of pages such as pricing.md. Its MCP docs are written for agent clients, and the full OpenAPI 3.0 spec is embedded in the API reference page, so an agent has machine-oriented entry points. The quoted llms.txt content is marketing copy, so its depth is unproven. Missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt indexes developer/API docs, an llms-full.txt or standalone raw OpenAPI download, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
